description: Variation of condition 2 (Development not in accordance) of planning permission 2022/0720 dated 23-04-2025 Demolition of existing structures , and erection of a two storey building to form Supermarket Class E(a).The variation requires removal of condition 8 (Decentralised Heat Network) amend condition 19 (Delivery & Servicing Plan) amend the condition from outside of hours of 08:00-18:00 Monday to Saturday to 06:00-08:00, 21:00-23:00 Monday to Saturday, 08:00-10:00 and 16:00-18:00 on Sundays and Bank Holiday,  removal of 2 accessible car parking bays condition 20 (Car parking Management Plan)
decision_conditions: <p><span style="color: rgb(51, 51, 51);">Prior to occupation, detailed drawings/full particulars of the proposed development showing the matters set out below must be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority, in writing. The development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with the details thus approved. </span></p><p><span style="color: rgb(51, 51, 51);">Details of the loading bay as subject to TfL discussions. </span></p><p><span style="color: rgb(51, 51, 51);">REASON: To ensure the location is satisfactory and does not impact upon the highways.</span></p>

<p><span style="color: rgb(51, 51, 51);">Before the development is operational, proof must be provided to and approved in writing by the local planning authority that the energy system installed is air quality neutral. This is because the AQA does not confirm that the energy system calculated in the air quality neutral assessment is the one that will be included in the development.</span></p><p><span style="color: rgb(51, 51, 51);"> REASON: To protect air quality and people’s health by ensuring that the production of air pollutants, such as nitrogen dioxide and particulate matter, is kept to a minimum during the lifetime of the development. To contribute towards the maintenance or to prevent further exceedances of National Air Quality Objectives .</span></p>

<p><span style="color: rgb(51, 51, 51);">Prior to occupation details for the provision of closed circuit television shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved scheme.&nbsp; </span></p><p><span style="color: rgb(51, 51, 51);">Reason: To provide safety and security for the premises.</span></p>

The Development hereby permitted shall only be carried out and completed strictly in accordance with the submitted plans hereby approved and any subsequent approval of details.


REASON: To ensure that the development hereby permitted is carried out in full accordance with the plans hereby approved.

<p><span style="color: rgb(51, 51, 51);">Prior to the occupation of the development hereby approved, full details including installation certificates by an MSC registered installer must be submitted to and approved by the local planning authority providing full details to demonstrate at least the following standards have been met, as set out in the hereby approved Energy Statement (dated 16/10/23 prepared by Synergy Building Services): a) Solar PV panels annual electricity generation of 35,115 kWh/yr&nbsp; b) Solar PV panels capacity of 45.5 kWp&nbsp; c) Solar PV panels array of 211.8 sqm The development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with the details thereby approved. </span></p><p><span style="color: rgb(51, 51, 51);">REASON: In the interest of addressing climate change and securing sustainable and net zero and net zero carbon development and construction.</span></p>

<p><span style="color: rgb(51, 51, 51);">No deliveries shall be taken or dispatched from the premises&nbsp;</span><span style="background-color: transparent; color: rgb(51, 51, 51); font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 11pt; white-space-collapse: preserve;">06:00-08:00, 21:00-23:00 Monday to Saturday, 08:00-10:00 and 16:00-18:00 on Sundays and Bank Holiday.</span></p><p><span id="docs-internal-guid-637cfb6a-7fff-745a-992a-a38b59d7e80a"><span style="font-size: 11pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; color: rgb(51, 51, 51); background-color: transparent; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline; white-space-collapse: preserve;">Reason: To safeguard from noise and disturbance of late night or early morning deliveries to residential occupiers.</span></span></p>

<p><span style="color: rgb(51, 51, 51);">Prior to occupation of the development, full details of the proposed cooling system (or any other related fixed plant adopted) specification and supporting drawings must be submitted to and approved by the local planning authority to demonstrate at least the following standards been achieved or improved upon as set out in the hereby approved Energy Statement (dated 16/10/23 prepared by Synergy Building Services): a) System Energy Efficiency Ratio of 4.5 b) Details of the location of the condenser units from the VRF systems (or any other fixed plant adopted) and noise solutions to mitigate the impact on nearby sensitive receptors;&nbsp; c) Details of refrigerants that are required, confirming a Low or Zero Global Warming Potential (GWP) and Zero Ozone Depleting Potential (ODP)&nbsp; d) Installation certificates by an MSC-registered installer The development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with the details thereby approved. </span></p><p><span style="color: rgb(51, 51, 51);">REASON: In the interest of addressing climate change and securing sustainable and net zero development and construction.</span></p>

<p><span style="color: rgb(51, 51, 51);">1. Prior to the above grade works of the development, the BREEAM Interim Design Certificate shall be submitted to and approved by the local planning authority, providing full details to demonstrate at least the following standards have been met, as set out in the hereby approved Energy Statement (dated 16/10/23 prepared by Synergy Building Services) - targeted credits must be presented in a tracker comparing credits targeted at BREEAM Pre Assessment stage: a) Minimum BREEAM Rating of 72.01% targeting the following credits: Ene 01, Ene 02 Ene 03, Ene 05, Ene 06, Wat 01, Wat 02, Wat 03, Wat 04, Mat 01, Mat 02, Mat 03, Mat 04, Mat 05, Mat 06, Wst 01, Wst 02, Wst 03, Wst 04,, Wst 05, Wst 06 The development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with the details thereby approved. </span></p><p><span style="color: rgb(51, 51, 51);">2. Within 12 weeks of occupation of the development, the BREEAM Final Design Certificate shall be submitted to and approved by the local planning authority, providing full details confirming the final rating and credits have been achieved or improved upon the pre-commencement figures - achieved credits must be presented in a tracker comparing credits achieved at BREEAM Interim Certification stage.&nbsp; </span></p><p><span style="color: rgb(51, 51, 51);">REASON: In the interest of addressing climate change and securing sustainable and net zero development and construction</span></p>

<p><span style="color: rgb(51, 51, 51);">Prior to occupation of the development hereby approved, a full air permeability test report confirming all units have achieved an air permeability of 3 m3/h/m2@50pa as set out in the hereby approved Energy Statement (dated 16/10/23 prepared by Synergy Building Services) shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. </span></p><p><span style="color: rgb(51, 51, 51);">REASON: In the interest of addressing climate change and securing sustainable and net zero development and construction.</span></p>

<p><span style="color: rgb(51, 51, 51);">Full details, and photo samples naming the materials to be used on the external surfaces of the building, including glazing, shall be submitted to and approved by the local planning authority, in writing, before the relevant work commences. The development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with the details thus approved.&nbsp; </span></p><p><span style="color: rgb(51, 51, 51);">REASON: To ensure that the external appearance of the building is satisfactory and does not detract from the character and visual amenity of the area .</span></p>

<p><span style="color: rgb(51, 51, 51);">Full details of cycle parking shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority, including details of the layout, foundation, stand type, and spacing. The cycle parking shall be made available before the first occupation of the development and retained in perpetuity. </span></p><p><span style="color: rgb(51, 51, 51);">REASON: To ensure that a reasonable provision is made within the site for the parking of bicycles in the interest of relieving congestion in surrounding streets and improving highway conditions in general .</span></p>

<p><span style="color: rgb(51, 51, 51);">Prior to the occupation of the development, a final “as-built” Energy Statement shall be submitted and approved by the local planning authority, confirming the following key metrics have been achieved or improved upon the pre-commencement figures:&nbsp; a) As-built U-values: walls/cladding; walls/non-cladding; floors; roof; windows and doors using 'through wall' calculations for each component and relevant datasheets&nbsp; b) As-built Space Heating demand in kWh/sqm/yr using as-built modelling calculations&nbsp; c) As-built Energy Use Intensity in kWh/sqm/yr using as-built modelling calculations&nbsp; d) Final GLA Carbon Emission Reporting Spreadsheet The final as-built GLA carbon Emission Reporting Spreadsheet should be submitted to the GLA at: ZeroCarbonPlanning@london.gov.uk , along with any supporting evidence as per the relevant GLA guidance https://www.london.gov.uk/programmes-strategies/planning/planning-applications-and-decisions/ pre-planning-application-meeting-service/energy-planning-guidance </span></p><p><span style="color: rgb(51, 51, 51);">REASON: In the interest of addressing climate change and securing sustainable and net-zero development and construction.</span></p>

<p><span style="color: rgb(51, 51, 51);">Prior to occupation of the development, full details including a proposed heating system (or any other related fixed plant adopted) specification and supporting drawings must be submitted to and approved by the local planning authority to demonstrate at least the following standards been achieved or improved upon as set out in the hereby approved Energy Statement (dated 16/10/23 prepared by Synergy Building Services) :&nbsp; a) Heat pump Coefficient of Performance of 3.16&nbsp; b) Details of refrigerants that are required, confirming a Low or Zero Global Warming Potential (GWP) and Zero Ozone Depleting Potential (ODP)&nbsp; c) Installation certificates by an MSC-registered installer. The development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with the details thereby approved. </span></p><p><span style="color: rgb(51, 51, 51);">REASON: In the interest of addressing climate change and securing sustainable and net zero development and construction.</span></p>

<p><span style="color: rgb(51, 51, 51);">Any plant shall be installed, together with any associated ancillary equipment, so as to prevent the transmission of noise and vibration into neighbouring premises. The rated noise level from all plant and ancillary equipment shall not increase the existing background sound level (LA90 15mins) when measured (LAeq 15mins) 1 metre external from the nearest residential or noise sensitive premises. An assessment of the expected noise levels shall be carried out in accordance with BS4142:2014+A1:2019 ‘Methods for rating and assessing industrial and commercial sound.’ Any mitigation measures necessary to achieve the above required noise levels shall be submitted to the local planning authority in writing for approval. The plant shall thereafter be installed and maintained in accordance with the approved details. </span></p><p><span style="color: rgb(51, 51, 51);">REASON: To ensure that occupiers of neighbouring premises do not suffer a loss of amenity by reason of noise nuisance and other excess noise.</span></p>

<p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.38;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:8pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the expiration of</span><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:700;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;"> </span><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">17 months beginning with the date of this permission.</span></p><p><span id="docs-internal-guid-de5f871b-7fff-213d-bdcd-b79cbfe071d0"></span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.38;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:8pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">REASON: In order to comply with the provisions of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended).</span></p><p>
</p>
